name: switch-output-checklist
description: Artifact-level validation checklist for generated New Zhanle switch-family components.

checks.question: Is the control classified as the correct switch-family subtype before styling?
checks.evidenceRequired: Subtype evidence: switch, segmented switch, checkbox, radio, or icon toggle.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the correct switch-family subtype, state model, and token rules from references/components-switch.md and references/switches/.

checks.question: Does each option group use one valid selection model without mixing radio and checkbox semantics?
checks.evidenceRequired: Option-group evidence showing single-choice groups use radio and multi-choice groups use checkbox.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the correct switch-family subtype, state model, and token rules from references/components-switch.md and references/switches/.

checks.question: Are switch-family dimensions, colors, states, and icon metrics sourced from approved switch tokens?
checks.evidenceRequired: Token usage list referencing assets/tokens/switch-tokens.json and canonical color tokens where applicable.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the correct switch-family subtype, state model, and token rules from references/components-switch.md and references/switches/.

checks.question: Are selected/unselected, on/off, disabled, and loading states handled where applicable?
checks.evidenceRequired: State evidence for every state supported by the chosen subtype.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the correct switch-family subtype, state model, and token rules from references/components-switch.md and references/switches/.

checks.question: Does the control avoid invented internal text or icons unless the subtype explicitly allows them?
checks.evidenceRequired: Structure evidence showing only segmented switches contain text inside the control, and icon toggles use approved icons.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the correct switch-family subtype, state model, and token rules from references/components-switch.md and references/switches/.

checks.question: Is the switch-family control used for state or selection rather than one-time actions?
checks.evidenceRequired: Interaction evidence showing the control represents on/off, selected/unselected, single-choice, multi-choice, or icon-toggle state.
checks.fixIfFail: Use ordinary button rules for one-time actions; keep switch-family rules for persistent state or selection.

checks.question: Is a segmented switch used only for local state/setting selection rather than page-level navigation tabs?
checks.evidenceRequired: Context evidence distinguishing local state selection from page section navigation; tabs route to components-tabs.
checks.fixIfFail: Route page navigation to tabs and local compact state selectors to segmented switch rules.

checks.question: Are eye/sound/watch/pin icon toggles used only in valid icon-toggle entries or explicit icon-toggle surfaces?
checks.evidenceRequired: Structure evidence showing the control is an icon-toggle entry, shortcut state entry, toolbar state action, or explicitly provided icon-toggle design.
checks.fixIfFail: Use standard switch, checkbox, radio, or segmented switch for setting-list and selection-list rows.

checks.question: Do used switch-family tokens resolve correctly in light and dark modes?
checks.evidenceRequired: Light/dark token comparison for all colors used by the switch-family component.
checks.fixIfFail: Apply the correct switch-family subtype, state model, and token rules from references/components-switch.md and references/switches/.
